meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重组输出以适配多动症读者:先给动作、分步骤、限时反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让写出的说明和通知更容易被多动症同事或客户看懂
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your instructions to be clearer for colleagues or customers with ADHD.

howto.what: 回复会改成：第一句给可执行的下一步；多步任务分编号；每一轮都说明目前进行到第几步；不写偏题内容；给具体时间估计；标明已完成的事；去掉开场白和收尾客套。
howto.when: 当你输入 /i-have-adhd 后启动，之后对每条消息都生效，直到你说“stop adhd mode”才关闭。

say.text: /i-have-adhd，然后告诉我第一步该做什么。
say.note: 激活 ADHD 模式并得到可执行的第一步。

say.text: 按编号列出修复 bug 需要的操作，每步给个时间估计。
say.note: 回复会生成带耗时的编号步骤。

say.text: 我已经完成第 2 步，下一步做什么？
say.note: Claude 会先确认当前进度再给下一行动。

howto.what_en: Replies become ADHD-friendly: lead with a concrete next action, number multi-step work, restate progress each turn, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make completed work visible, and drop all pleasantries.
howto.when_en: Activates when user says "/i-have-adhd"; applies to every message until user says "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: /i-have-adhd, then tell me the first thing to do.
say_en.note: Enables ADHD mode and gets a concrete next action.

say_en.text: List the steps to fix the bug, numbered, with time estimates.
say_en.note: You get numbered steps with durations.

say_en.text: I have completed step 2; what is next?
say_en.note: Claude restates progress before giving the next action.
